subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu bot-authored group messages become an explicit opt-in that disables previously reachable bot ingress by default and uses non-streaming, payload-correct replies when enabled?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but the default admission and rendering transition can change existing installations and therefore needs intentional product ownership rather than an automated merge judgment.

options.title: Accept the opt-in transition
options.body: Keep `allowBots` disabled by default, align all upgrade wording, and intentionally accept non-streaming replies for enabled bot-to-bot turns.

options.title: Preserve prior admission
options.body: Default bot-authored ingress to its previously reachable behavior while retaining `false` as an explicit restriction, then re-prove fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow or pause the feature
options.body: Split out only reusable mention or loop-safety work if maintainers do not want supported Feishu bot-to-bot conversation semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in transition
recommendation.body: Keep `allowBots` disabled by default, align all upgrade wording, and intentionally accept non-streaming replies for enabled bot-to-bot turns.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and authored the current implementation and refinement commits, making them the clearest available owner for this product and compatibility choice.
